reason: I already have a crew I trust, or at least someone in mind, so I only need the paperwork and payment done. Paying a platform to do that is not worth it unless it also tells me the builder is good, and this offer does not say that.
objection: Who checks that the builder is any good? A friend's renovation ran over budget and dragged on for months, and a platform that just handles the contract and the money does not stop that happening.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that the platform vets builders properly, with checked references and past finished jobs I can look at, plus payment held back until each stage of work is signed off.
